rule msr_indep_4x2 {
	id 0
	type msr_indep
	step take default
	step choosemsr 4 type host
	step choosemsr 2 type osd
	step emit
}

	id 1
	type msr_firstn

	id 2
	type msr_indep
	step set_msr_descents 20
	step set_msr_collision_tries 10
	step take default
	step choosemsr 0 type host
	step choosemsr 1 type osd
	step emit
}

	type msr_firstn
